item.title: Wildfire awareness week on the calendar
item.description: The threat of wildfire in Harvey County is real, with fire crews always on alert. In November crews responded to the area near North River Park Road between Northwest 12th and 24th streets where a controlled burn went out of controll fueled by high winds. About 15 acres were burned.

item.title: ‘A Great Crime-Fighting Tool’: Flock cameras boost sheriff’s office
item.description: The Harvey County Sheriff’s Office currently operates four Flock cameras to monitor vehicle traffic, and according to Sheriff Chad Gay, deputies are using them more effectively as they gain experience with both the cameras and the software that runs them.
